protocol: Post-hoc generic parenthetical-name coverage scan prompted by an observed alias discrepancy; no inference or model edits.

checked.interpretation: Post-hoc literal coverage flag only. An absent name is not a verified source identity; this does not establish the true alias or constitute human adjudication.

findings.interpretation: Post-hoc literal coverage flag only. An absent name is not a verified source identity; this does not establish the true alias or constitute human adjudication.

scope: The scan is not a comprehensive semantic audit and its selected names are not an independent evaluation sample.
